releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.9.9 (Unified Single Text Tool & Anti-Regression Architecture)
changelog:
✨ Unified CamScanner-Style Single Text Tool:
• Single Text Tool: Unified Edit Text and Add Text into one seamless Text tool.
• Tap Word -> Auto-Fetch: Touching any detected word instantly selects and autofetches it into the editor.
• Tap Blank -> Insert: Touching any blank area instantly opens insertion cursor at that coordinate.
• Zero Interception: Removed fragmented gesture handlers and overlapping banners.
• Clean UI: Removed all confusing fake PRO badges.
